name: mellions
description: Engineering responsibility and reliability for frontier coding agents: continuity, ownership, falsification, coordination, and disciplined completion.

interface.shortDescription: Engineering discipline for frontier coding agents.
interface.longDescription: Mellions gives a capable coding agent durable engineering responsibility across sessions: ownership, continuity, situational awareness, falsification, coordination, disciplined completion, and intelligent escalation. The runtime and model keep their native reasoning, tools, permissions, and engineering capability.
defaultPrompt: Re-establish what engineering responsibility you are carrying.
Survey the current engineering state and choose the most useful actionable work.
Challenge the completion evidence before declaring this done.
